A CLOSER LOOK

Built around
your formulas.

What does Evaltra calculate?+

Evaltra evaluates supported spreadsheet formulas and recalculates dependent cells when inputs change. It handles the relationships between cells and sheets, so your application can work with the model’s results.

Why do runtime dependencies matter?+

A formula can contain a reference that its calculation never needs. In the IF example above, the false condition selects 42 and leaves the self-reference unused. Evaltra follows that active path. When a real circular dependency is active, it reports the cycle.

Can I use an existing Excel workbook?+

Evaltra opens XLSX workbooks and calculates supported formulas. Validate the formulas and workbook features your application relies on before production use.

VBA and UDF execution, Power Query, automatic external-link refresh and iterative circular calculation are outside the runtime scope. Numeric compatibility and XLSX preservation have open work; successful import does not guarantee support for every workbook feature.

Which library should I choose?+

Use WASM for browser applications, Rust for native embedding, and Python for scripts, notebooks and data jobs. Choose the library that matches where your application runs and manages its workbooks.
